isabel: Quick heads-up — a couple of new hires in APAC said the orientation shows the wrong local time. Can we make the event explicit?

kevin: Yep. Change the calendar timezone to America/Los_Angeles and re-send the invite.

anya: Done. I set TZ to America/Los_Angeles and re-attached an ICS. I also added an explicit ISO start time to the description: 2026-09-14T10:00:00-07:00 (PT).

isabel: Nice. Can we paste the raw Zoom join + passcode and a fallback URL in the description so mobile clients don't lose params?

anya: Added: 
Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/5556667777?pwd=onboard
Passcode: Hi2026
Fallback: https://zoom.us/w/5556667777

kevin: Onboarding-bot, will the session be recorded and where will the link be posted?

onboarding-bot: Recording will be uploaded to s3://redwood-onboarding/recordings and a public share link posted to #new-hires within 30 minutes after the meeting. Retention: 90 days.

isabel: I'll DM APAC new hires the PT time and ask them to "Add to calendar" manually if their clients auto-accept.

anya: Also pinned the ISO time and raw link in the event and put a note for hosts: include join URL on first slide.

kevin: Perfect. If anyone still sees weird times, reply here and we'll create one-off invites. :thumbsup:
